android_mechanism: Check whether a download is really required before performing it (static assets re-fetched every time)
bug_description: The weather condition glyphs (sunny/cloudy/overcast/rain) are rendered from four hard-coded remote CDN URLs (i-blog.csdnimg.cn). The forecast view shows ~9 icon instances per city tab (big current-weather icon plus per-day day/night icons); every cold start and every cache miss re-downloads these static images over the network, delaying first paint of the weather panel and wasting bandwidth.
fix_summary: The four weather glyphs are bundled as local rawfile resources and referenced with $rawfile, eliminating the network fetches and speeding up first render.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

evidence.note: icons come from a remote CDN on every cold start; fixed loads them from local resources, so fetch+decode instructions dominate the diff

mechanism_oracle.definition: (a) Time from page build start to weather-icon render completion in the ace trace; (b) bytes of image downloads to the icon CDN observed in the network trace.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed downloads ~9 images (hundreds of KB) before/while icons appear and shows network stalls on cold start; fixed has zero icon-related network traffic and near-instant icon paint.

reproduction: git -C hosts/weatherassistant checkout case/weatherassistant_remote_weather_icons/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/weatherassistant checkout case/weatherassistant_remote_weather_icons/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
